body.x: CreamOFF (CEO DoHyuck Jason Kwon) announced its participation in CES 2025, which will be held from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas. The company will exhibit at the K-Startup Pavilion.

CreamOFF, a South Korean company, focuses on enhancing the quality of life for pets and their families by developing and operating pet care solutions and SaaS (Software as a Service) platforms. The company uses advanced technology to improve pet health and welfare while maximizing customer convenience and efficiency through user-friendly digital services.

At CES, CreamOFF will showcase its AI-based pet health management solution. The solution combines wearable devices with a dedicated mobile application to monitor pets' vital signs, such as heart rate and oxygen saturation, using photoplethysmography (PPG) technology.

The wearable device, which resembles a collar or harness, is designed to be comfortable and nonintrusive for most pets. It is equipped with sensors and an AI-driven analytics algorithm, which provides reliable monitoring results. The analyzed data is displayed on a mobile app dashboard, allowing pet owners to track their pets’ health in real time easily. The solution also aids in the early detection of potential health issues, such as heart conditions, supporting preventive care.

CreamOFF is also building a comprehensive pet healthcare ecosystem. The company collaborates with local veterinary clinics to provide specialized health management services, including appointment scheduling. Additionally, it is partnering with research institutions to enhance the reliability and sophistication of its platform.

A CreamOFF representative stated, "CES 2025 is the ideal platform to introduce our pet care solution and SaaS platform to the global market. We aim to establish networks with potential customers and partners from various countries and explore overseas distribution and collaboration opportunities.”

The company also intends to use the event to promote its growth potential and vision to venture capitalists and accelerators, seeking new investments to support its business diversification and global expansion. "Our ultimate goal is to strengthen CreamOFF's presence in the global pet care market, particularly in North America, to make a meaningful impact," the representative added.

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
